layers.name: Card body
layers.text:
Knowing is a closed room. You have already
decided what is in it, so the prose comes out
furnished and dull.

Noticing sends you back outside. It asks what
the light was doing, who spoke first, which
detail refused to leave. That is a draft with
something worth cutting toward.
